# Lending Policy Update and Monitoring Requirements

**Department:** Credit & Loans (CRL)
**Document Type:** Lending Policy
**Reference ID:** CRL-BATCH-078
**Date:** 2026-04-11

--- Confidential Bank Document ---

## Action Items and Monitoring Requirements:

*   Investigate the collateral value standard update.
*   Update the borrower credit score based on audit findings.
*   Update the default risk urgently.
*   Monitor the collateral value quarterly.
*   Monitor the interest rates standard update.
